cases.label: MISSING_RELATIONAL_CONTEXTUAL_SEMANTICS
cases.rationale: T2 models request-derived IDs flowing to generic sensitive operations and suppresses results when an authentication context is present, but it does not encode the decisive equality/authorization relation between the requested user ID and the authenticated session identity.
cases.actual_mechanism: Authorization depends on binding the requested target user identity to the authenticated session identity.

cases.label: WRONG_VULNERABILITY_MECHANISM
cases.rationale: The certificate-reuse mechanism is explicitly marked UNENCODABLE_OR_BOUNDED and no certificate type/OID/SCA-versus-identity validation appears in the query.
cases.actual_mechanism: Authentication must distinguish the permitted identity certificate from an SCA certificate using certificate type/OID/attribute validation.

cases.label: MISSING_RELATIONAL_CONTEXTUAL_SEMANTICS
cases.rationale: The generic IDOR branch does not model authenticated Principal propagation or the subject-to-organization/user/API-key/password target relation and scope.
cases.actual_mechanism: The authenticated Principal must be propagated and enforced across organization/user/API-key/password operations with the correct subject-scope-target relation.

cases.label: MISSING_RELATIONAL_CONTEXTUAL_SEMANTICS
cases.rationale: The query does not require the selected/exposed user to derive from the authenticated session user; auth-context presence is only used as an exclusion.
cases.actual_mechanism: The selected or exposed user must derive from the authenticated session user rather than an externally supplied user identifier.

cases.label: MISSING_RELATIONAL_CONTEXTUAL_SEMANTICS
cases.rationale: The query recognizes ID-like arguments and sensitive operations but does not encode ownership/authorization between requester and dashboard/message resource.
cases.actual_mechanism: Dashboard/message operations require an ownership or authorization relation between requester and target resource ID.

cases.label: WRONG_VULNERABILITY_MECHANISM
cases.rationale: The frozen plan grouped this with an optional/missing identity/configuration-key family, but the generated query contains no JDBC sensitive-parameter filtering or dangerous-parameter validation semantics.
cases.actual_mechanism: Security-sensitive JDBC parameter keys must be filtered or replaced so dangerous parameters cannot bypass sensitive-parameter checks.

cases.label: WRONG_VULNERABILITY_MECHANISM
cases.rationale: The optional-identity-component family is marked UNENCODABLE_OR_BOUNDED and the query contains no ZooKeeper quorum SASL authentication-ID instance-component or skipped-authorization control-flow semantics.
cases.actual_mechanism: ZooKeeper quorum SASL authorization must not be skipped when the optional instance component of the authentication ID is absent.

interpretation: The structured-contract intervention changed failure transparency but did not improve semantic alignment before CodeQL evaluation. T2 explicitly marked two of three mechanism families UNENCODABLE_OR_BOUNDED instead of silently collapsing them. However, the one family claimed ENCODED remains a generic request-ID-to-sensitive-operation taint abstraction with an authentication-context exclusion heuristic, not an implemented ownership or session-identity relation. Therefore semantic alignment remains 0/7.
